name: THE FIZZ Frankfurt
address: Mainzer Landstraße 323, Frankfurt am Main, Hessen 60326
about: THE FIZZ Frankfurt is a modern student accommodation in Frankfurt, sited at Mainzer Landstraße 323, Gallus, 60326 Frankfurt am Main. Living in the bustling Gallus district, Goethe University Frankfurt is just a 15-minute bike ride away. THE FIZZ Frankfurt offers a sophisticated "all-in" living concept designed for students who seek both privacy and a vibrant community. This modern residence features 381 fully furnished apartments ranging from Single Studios to spacious Double Units, and the all-in-one price offers a hassle-free living experience. The building's highlight is the 10th-floor rooftop terrace, where you can enjoy a breathtaking panoramic view of Frankfurt's iconic "Mainhattan" skyline. With its central location, commuting is a breeze: the tram and bus stations are right at your doorstep, and you can easily access your campus or other corners of the city. From a high-tech gym to an in-house cinema, THE FIZZ provides everything you need to balance your studies and social life. At acolyteliving.com, we simplify the international student rental process. You can complete your booking and get support in your native tongue, even if you don't speak a word of German! By booking early through our platform, you can secure Early Bird Discounts to lock in the best rates for the upcoming semester.THE FIZZ Frankfurt FeaturesRoom TypesEach apartment at THE FIZZ is designed for maximum efficiency and comfort. All rooms include a comfortable bed, a spacious desk with a chair, ample storage/wardrobes, and high-speed Wi-Fi. We offer various room types to suit your lifestyle:Single Studios: Self-contained units with a private kitchenette and ensuite bathroom.Double Apartments: Ideal for sharing with a friend, featuring two work areas and extra space.Premium Units: Options with upgraded furniture, Smart TVs, and coffee machines.Apartment FeaturesLiving and Working Area: Comfortable bed with mattress, ergonomic desk and chair, spacious wardrobe featuring a mirror, blackout curtains for optimal rest, a versatile modular rail system with pinboard and intercom, plus ample additional storage options.Kitchenette: Fully equipped with two ceramic hobs, a combination microwave, refrigerator including freezer compartment, sink, and generous countertop space.Private Bathroom: Modern tiled bathroom complete with toilet, washbasin and mirror, along with extra storage for convenience.Community FacilitiesStep out of your room and enjoy a wealth of shared spaces designed for socializing and productivity:Rooftop Terrace: A scenic 10th-floor terrace perfect for evening relaxation and city gazing.Modern Gym: Fully equipped with the latest fitness gear—save on your monthly gym membership!In-house Cinema: A dedicated movie lounge where you can host screenings with friends.Study & Work Spaces: Quiet areas and co-working zones for focused individual or group study.Social Hubs: A large community kitchen, gaming area (foosball/billiards), and lounge area.Security & ServicesSafety: Building access restricted to security card holders only. Continuous video surveillance in place, with weekend patrols by security personnel to maintain safety and order.Practical Services: On-site management, parcel reception, laundry room, and secure bicycle storage.Tools, including irons, games, and vacuum cleaners, are available free to borrow at reception.Location & What's Hot NearbyLocated at Mainzer Landstraße 323, you are in the heart of the dynamic Gallusviertel, a district that perfectly blends urban convenience with local charm.Commute to Universities:Goethe University (Westend Campus): ~15 mins by bike / ~30 mins via public transport.Frankfurt School of Finance & Management: ~35 mins by public transport.Frankfurt University of Applied Sciences: ~22 mins by bike / ~37 mins via tram.Supermarkets & Shopping:Rewe & Penny Supermarkets: Just a 3-5 minute walk away for all your daily groceries.Skyline Plaza: (10 mins by tram) A massive shopping mall with over 170 shops, a food court, and a rooftop garden.Dining & Cafés:Pizzeria Olbia: (4 mins walk) A local favorite for authentic Italian pizza.Mainzer Landstraße Cafés: Numerous artisanal bakeries and coffee shops are within a 5-minute walk for your morning caffeine fix.Parks & Leisure:Europagarten: (14 mins walk) A vast green space perfect for jogging, picnics, or outdoor study sessions.Main River Bank: (15 mins by bike) The ideal spot for a sunset stroll or cycling.Popular Landmarks:Frankfurt Messe (Trade Fair): (20 mins by tram) A world-renowned hub for international events.Main Tower: (18 mins by S-Bahn) Visit the observation deck for a different perspective of the city.TransportationTHE FIZZ Frankfurt boasts an unbeatable location with public transport links literally at your front door, making the entire city accessible within minutes.Public Transit at Doorstep:Tram Stop (Galluspark): 1-minute walk. Lines 11 and 21 take you directly to the Main Station (Hauptbahnhof) and the City Center.S-Bahn (Galluswarte): 8-minute walk. Connects you to the S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, and S6 lines.Train & Airport:Frankfurt Central Station (Hauptbahnhof): 8 mins by tram.Frankfurt Airport (FRA): ~20-25 mins via S-Bahn (S8/S9) from Galluswarte or Hauptbahnhof.
